title: The American Medical Directory Panel: Comparing AI-Assisted and LLM Transcription with Manual Data Entry at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.25218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How closely does machine transcription agree with manual double-entry data? We digitize the 1912 and 1921 editions of the American Medical Directory, a national register of US physicians with roughly 140,000 and 150,000 entries in the two volumes, and compare five machine-extraction workflows with a full-count double-entered manual transcription. Like many historical directories, the AMD is semi-structured rather than tabular, so errors arise from misreading the layout as well as the text. A script that parses commercial OCR text using rules written by coding agents recovers about 97 percent of manually transcribed records with similar precision, more than a multimodal language model workflow (gemini-2.0.flash) that reads the page images and the OCR text. When the two methods fail, they fail on partly overlapping sets of records, so reconciling their outputs raises both recall and precision to about 98 percent. An open-weight LLM pipel

translated_title: 美国医学名录面板：大规模比较AI辅助与LLM转录同人工数据录入的效果
translated_abstract: 机器转录与人工双录入数据的一致性究竟有多高？我们数字化了1912年和1921年版的《美国医学名录》，这是一份美国医师的全国名册，两卷分别收录约14万和15万条记录，并将五种机器提取工作流程与全量双录入的人工转录结果进行比较。与许多历史名录类似，AMD是半结构化而非表格化的，因此错误不仅源于对文本的误读，也源于对版面布局的误判。一个使用由编码智能体编写的规则来解析商业OCR文本的脚本，能够以相近的精确度恢复约97%的人工转录记录，其表现优于同时读取页面图像和OCR文本的多模态语言模型工作流程（gemini-2.0.flash）。当两种方法失败时，它们失败的记录集仅部分重叠，因此对两者的输出进行调和可将召回率和精确度均提升至约98%。一个开放权重的LLM流水线……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究数字化了约15万条《美国医学名录》记录，发现基于编码智能体规则的OCR解析脚本与多模态LLM工作流程的失败案例部分互补，二者调和可将转录召回率与精确度提升至约98%，接近人工双录入水平。
en_tdlr: By digitizing roughly 150,000 records from the American Medical Directory, this study shows that an OCR-parsing script with coding-agent-written rules (97% recall) and a multimodal LLM workflow fail on partly overlapping records, and reconciling their outputs raises recall and precision to about 98%, approaching manual double-entry quality.
